title: Magnetic N-doped CNT stabilized Cu2O as a catalyst for N-arylation of nitriles and aryl halides in a biocompatible deep eutectic solvent
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,8195-8206
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA00849B, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Mohadeseh Alizadeh, Arefe Salamatmanesh, Masoumeh Jadidi Nejad, Akbar Heydari
This study documented the hydrolysis of nitriles by copper(I) oxide immobilized on nitrogen-doped carbon nanotubes (N-CNT/Fe3O4–Cu2O) to yield corresponding amides in the presence of a deep eutectic solvent (ChOH/Gly).
